'''Rodese''' or '''Rodian''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]. Many Rodians living away from [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] spoke other languages more frequently, especially [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].

==Words used as masculine given names==
*''[[Avaro Sookcool|Avaro]]'' – charming, eloquent
*[[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|''Bodonawieedo'']] – backward (literally "doing things in the most difficult way imaginable")
*''[[Boiny]]'' – reliable
*[[Capo (Peace Brigade)|''Capo'']] – brave
*[[Cevva Xuz|''Cevva'']] – philosophical
*''[[Clezo]]'' – curious
*''Dar'' – happy
*''[[Dardo]]'' &ndash; familial
*[[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|''Doda'']] – bold
*''Don'' – mysterious
*[[Onaconda Farr/Legends|''Farr'']] – keen-eyed
*''[[Geelo]]'' &ndash; sly
*''Gen'' – clumsy
*[[Grappa (Rodian)|''Grappa'']] – aggressive
*[[Greedo/Legends|''Greedo'']] – ambitious
*''Harido'' – deceptive
*''[[Honka]]'' – vital, vigorous
*[[Jannik (Rodian)|''Jannik'']] – just
*''Kavilo'' – poetic
*''Kelbis'' &ndash; protective
*''[[Kelko]]'' – resourceful
*[[Koobis (First Jedi Purge)|''Koobis'']] – mighty
*''[[Leenik]]'' – skillful
*''Lido'' – lonely
*''Maris'' – industrious
*''[[Menndo]]'' – poor
*''Mufrenes'' – melancholy
*''Nardi'' – dramatic
*''Narik'' – bright
*''[[Navik/Legends|Navik]]'' – dark (considered a prophetic name)
*[[Neesh/Legends|''Neesh'']] – loud
*[[Nok (Rodian)|''Nok'']] – difficult, obstinate
*''Nu'' – quiet, closemouthed
*[[Onaconda Farr/Legends|''Onaconda'']] – considerate (literally "living others' lives")
*''[[Pqweeduk]]'' – verbose
*''[[Prevaro]]'' – regal, noble
*''Rohan'' – dutiful
*[[Bolla Ropal/Legends|''Ropal'']] – trustworthy
*''Shodu'' – vengeful
*[[Skee (Rodian)|''Skee'']] – charismatic
*[[Avaro Sookcool|''Sookcool'']] – wealthy
*''Standro'' – resolute
*''[[Teeku]]'' – commanding
*''[[Teerik]]'' – spiritual
*''[[Thuku]]'' – stoic
*''Tox'' – quick-witted
*''[[Vinto]]'' – vicious
*''Vuko'' – deft, dexterous
*[[Dar Wac/Legends|''Wac'']] – fortunate
*''Wald'' – song
*[[Cevva Xuz|''Xuz'']] – intellectual

==Words used as feminine given names==
*[[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|''Greeata'']] &ndash; talented
*[[Hreeda Bomu|''Hreeda'']] &ndash; vengeful
*[[Lolo Purs/Legends|''Lolo'']] &ndash; traitorous

==Other terms and phrases==
*''Te kalya skrek grulla woska!'' &ndash; Put me down, you hairy heap!
*''T-te jacta.'' &ndash; I'll get you for this.
*''Cthn rulyen stka wen!'' &ndash; Wow, that's great!
*''Skak, trn kras ka noota.'' &ndash; All right, then give me the money.
*''Vnu sna (being's name) vorskl ta.'' &ndash; Then ( being's name) will be on his way.
*''Nvtuta bork te ptu motta. Tni snato.'' &ndash; No, get it right now. I'll wait.
*''Prog mnete enyaz ftt sove shuss.'' &ndash; Make it four thousand credits.
*''Wknuto.'' &ndash; Thanks.
*''Rylun pa getpa gushu?'' &ndash; Enjoy your breakfast?
*''Fna ho koru gep. Kras ka noota.'' &ndash; Don't be funny. Give me the money.
*''Ka noota! Grot pleno ka [being's name] spulta?'' &ndash; The money! Or would you like to explain to [being's name] personally?
*''Nchtha zno ta. Fnrt pwusko vtulla pa.'' &ndash; I'm not sure. [[I have a bad feeling about this|I'm getting a bad feeling.]]
*''Oona goota?'' &ndash; Going somewhere?<ref name="Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina">''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''</ref>
*''Alquono deg apprefaron'' &ndash; Expression of gratitude
*''Goa-Ato'' &ndash; [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Grand Protector's Hunter's Guild]]
*''[[Grand Protector/Legends|Inta'si'rin'na]]'' &ndash; Grand Protector of the Rodians
*''Ittu'' (Pronounced ''ee-chu'') &ndash; [curse word]
*''Si'rin'ha'' &ndash; chief protector [used to describe the best hunter of a clan]
